Disk Inventory X2 needs access to Desktop file metadata in your selected scan to measure names, types and sizes. Scanning does not read file contents or delete files.

Disk Inventory X2 needs access to contact database file metadata in your selected scan to measure names, types and sizes. Scanning does not read contact records or other file contents or delete files.
